world.h: Iran warns of wider retaliation as Israel readies possible strike
world.b: Israel's security cabinet ordered the military to step up preparations for an attack on Iran, Israeli media reported, and Iran warned it would expand the war beyond the region if attacked. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot urged caretaker PM Netanyahu not to act without an immediate threat.
world.title: Iran warns of expanded retaliation as Israel reportedly readies to attack

world.h: US, Mexico and Guatemala at risk of losing measles-free status
world.b: A Pan American Health Organization commission is reviewing measles elimination across the Americas this week. The US, which has held the status since 2000, is facing its largest and deadliest outbreak in nearly 30 years.

world.h: Iran says Hormuz will 'never return' to pre-war status
world.b: Iranian official Ghalibaf said the strait is governed by the laws of the two states bordering it, and that Iran sent its seven conditions for talks to the US through a Qatari mediator and awaits a reply.

world.h: Russia's ambassador to the US dies suddenly
world.b: Moscow announced the death of Alexander Darchiev, its envoy to Washington since last March and a specialist in Russia-US relations, without giving details.

world.h: Russia-Ukraine talks end with deal on prisoner swap
world.b: US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi ended with agreement on a large-scale prisoner exchange, expected within weeks. US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will brief Putin in Moscow, then meet Zelenskyy in Dublin.

world.h: Iran says ball is in US court and a deal is possible
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: Iran war updates: Tehran says ball in US court, deal possible

world.h: Iran denies talks with US, says Hormuz stays shut
world.b: Iranian official Mohsen Rezaei called reports of negotiations or a meeting in Qatar "a pure lie" and said the Strait of Hormuz won't reopen until the US meets Tehran's seven conditions. Trump said new attacks on Iran were unnecessary.

world.h: Ebola cases in DR Congo pass 11,000
world.b: The outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo strain has now infected more than 11,000 people and killed 5,387, the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. No vaccine or treatment exists for the strain, and eight of 26 provinces are affected.

national.h: Guard reprimands Hegseth entourage at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
national.b: Video shows an Old Guard sentinel loudly telling members of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's group to keep silence and respect after they laughed while taking photos on Veterans Day.

national.h: Bessent moves to military base over safety concerns
national.b: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after media reports helped identify his home address, as he leads a sweeping financial campaign against Iran and US intelligence shows Tehran stepping up efforts to target Americans, the AP reported.

national.h: SS United States to become a reef off Florida
national.b: The historic ocean liner, which still holds the trans-Atlantic speed record from its 1952 maiden voyage, was set to be intentionally sunk off the Florida panhandle Wednesday.
national.title: WATCH LIVE: SS United States, once world’s fastest ocean liner, sinks to become reef off Florida

national.b: Keach, known for playing detective Mike Hammer, Frank James in 'The Long Riders' and Hamlet on stage, died at his family's home in Poland after a long battle with heart failure, his wife said.
national.title: Actor Stacy Keach, who played a private eye and plenty more, dies at 85

national.h: Kennedy family sues to block Trump's arch
national.b: Nine Kennedy relatives filed a federal lawsuit to stop the proposed 250-foot arch, saying it would cast a shadow over gravesites at Arlington National Cemetery, including JFK's Eternal Flame.
national.title: Kennedy relatives join the fight against Trump's arch, alleging harm to JFK's grave

national.h: AI-voiced hoax calls are fooling 911 dispatchers
national.b: Swatting calls made with AI-generated voices, like a bomb threat that closed a Yuba County, California, high school in August, are getting harder for emergency dispatchers to detect.

national.h: Veterans hospital in crisis after VA cuts
national.b: A ProPublica investigation finds the VA hospital in East Orange, New Jersey, struggling after the administration's dismantling of the VA, including an operating room closed by a broken ventilation system and short-staffed repair crews.
national.title: Trump Promised to Care for America’s Veterans. The VA Is Now “Collapsing From the Inside.”

politics.h: Biden says he wouldn't have run again had he known of cancer
politics.b: In a People interview ahead of his memoir's release, Joe Biden said he would not have sought a second term if he had known he had cancer. He was diagnosed with metastatic prostate cancer months after leaving office.
politics.title: Biden says he wouldn't have run for a second term in 2024 if he knew he had cancer

politics.h: House GOP Epstein report finds 'repeated failures'
politics.b: A 136-page report from House Oversight Republicans concluded that Jeffrey Epstein's crimes after 2005 could have been prevented but for repeated failures by law enforcement and federal prosecutors.
politics.title: 4 key findings in the Jeffrey Epstein report from GOP-led House Oversight panel

politics.h: Trump's $10 billion BBC defamation suit can proceed
politics.b: A federal judge in Florida let Trump's defamation claim over a BBC documentary move forward without ruling on its merits, but dismissed a claim under the state's unfair business practices law.
politics.title: Judge allows Trump defamation case against BBC to proceed but tosses 1 claim

politics.h: Peltola campaign sues over rejected Alaska ballots
politics.b: A state judge promised a swift ruling on Mary Peltola's lawsuit seeking the list of rejected absentee voters in her close Senate race against Republican Dan Sullivan. The state says releasing it would violate voter privacy.

politics.h: White House warns Democrats against investigations
politics.b: White House counsel Will Scharf wrote to Rep. Robert Garcia, likely the next House Oversight chair, suggesting planned probes of the administration may amount to "blatant criminality." Garcia had told Trump officials to "lawyer up."

politics.h: Critics slam DOJ moves to erase Trump allies' convictions
politics.b: The Justice Department asked a court to drop Steve Bannon's contempt of Congress conviction, which an appeals court upheld, and Bannon's lawyers don't object. Legal experts say it fits a pattern of unopposed dismissals for Trump allies.

politics.h: Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat, a historic first
politics.b: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith after a prolonged count, becoming Mississippi's first Black US senator since Reconstruction, the AP projected.
politics.title: Scott Colom wins Senate election in Mississippi

international.h: Houthis deny targeting Mecca as Yemen fighting intensifies
international.b: The Houthis said they targeted a pumping station in Yanbu and Riyadh's airport, not Mecca, after Saudi-led forces said they intercepted missiles and drones. Saudi civil defence said debris fell in a village in Mecca province.
international.title: Fighting intensifies in Yemen as Houthis deny targeting Mecca

international.h: Bolivia arrests ex-judge on drug trafficking suspicion
international.b: Former Santa Cruz chief justice Quezada, who resigned after landing on a US visa restriction list, is among several senior Bolivian judicial officials arrested since September over alleged cartel links.

international.h: Amnesty: UN and South Sudan failed to prevent village massacre
international.b: Amnesty says UN peacekeepers and officials knew an attack on Abiemnom was likely but didn't reinforce about three dozen troops before the March 1 assault, which killed more than 200 people.
international.title: Amnesty says UN, South Sudan officials failed to prevent village massacre

international.h: Ex-Red Brigades member escapes house arrest in Argentina
international.b: Leonardo Bertulazzi, facing extradition to serve a 27-year sentence in Italy over the kidnapping and killing of a former prime minister, slipped out over neighbouring terraces, prompting a nationwide search.

international.h: Israeli strikes kill five in Gaza, including at tent camp
international.b: Strikes killed Palestinians across Gaza, including two in an attack on a tent sheltering displaced people in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood.
international.title: Deadly Israeli air strike hits hospital, 13 killed across Gaza

international.h: Iran labels Argentina's navy and air force terrorist groups
international.b: Iran designated Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organisations, citing reciprocity. Argentina's foreign ministry "categorically" rejected the move as baseless.

international.h: More than a million in Lebanon face acute hunger
international.b: A joint UN and Lebanese agriculture ministry statement warned the number is expected to rise to 1.15 million by mid-2027 as savings run out and food and fuel costs strain households.

international.h: Tens of thousands join Poland's nationalist march
international.b: Marchers filled Warsaw for the annual Independence Day march, long criticized for anti-Semitic and anti-immigration rhetoric, which supporters call an expression of national pride.

international.h: Storm Charles shuts Portugal's schools and grounds flights
international.b: Portugal canceled more than 300 flights and about 8,000 schools closed as the Atlantic storm brought gusts above 120km/h. Lisbon streets flooded as people stayed home on government advice.

international.h: Rights group raises alarm over jailed Gaza doctor
international.b: Physicians for Human Rights Israel says a review of Dr. Hussam Abu Safia's records shows a 14kg weight loss in four months and untreated chest pain, and is petitioning to free 14 Gaza doctors held without charge.

international.h: Hundreds of Italian schools evacuated over email bomb threats
international.b: Schools across Italy were evacuated after emailed bomb alerts that also threatened Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni. The same purported author claimed earlier threats to newsrooms in Ireland and Bulgaria, amid wider worry about hybrid attacks in Europe.

international.h: Spain's first general strike in 14 years targets housing crisis
international.b: Millions of workers walked off the job to demand action on housing, slowing transit in Barcelona and Madrid and closing many schools, less than three weeks before a national election.

international.h: Yemeni government forces and Houthis trade heavy attacks
international.b: Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces said they hit Houthi positions in six governorates with air strikes, drones and artillery, claiming about 190 fighters killed or injured. Al Jazeera could not verify the claims.

international.h: Russia says it downed 146 drones over Leningrad region
international.b: Russia claimed to intercept 146 drones over the Leningrad region, where a drone attack sparked a fire at Ust-Luga port. The strikes came as US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi entered their final day, which Zelenskyy called constructive.

international.h: Former Iraqi lawmaker found dead in Beirut
international.b: Ahmed al-Alwani's body was found in an apartment in Beirut's Tariq al-Jdideh neighbourhood. His office called it an assassination, and Lebanon's top prosecutor is overseeing the investigation.

Gibran Rakabuming Raka, son of former President Joko Widodo, submitted his resignation two years into his term amid court rulings disputing his educational credentials. Parliament will pick a replacement from two presidential nominees within 60 days.
international.title: Indonesia vice president resigns amid dispute over eligibility

business.h: Nvidia shares plunge as board weighs Huang's future
business.b: Nvidia stock fell after reports its board will discuss CEO Jensen Huang's position over alleged affairs, including one with a woman accused of working with Chinese intelligence. The company opened an investigation Sunday.
business.title: Nvidia shares plunge amid reports board to discuss CEO Huang’s future

business.h: Home equity borrowing jumps the most since 2005
business.b: HELOC balances rose $23 billion in the third quarter, the New York Fed reported, as homeowners locked into low mortgage rates tap equity instead of moving.

business.h: Gas falls below $4 a gallon for first time in months
business.b: The national average for regular dropped to $3.94, AAA says, down about 40 cents in a month. GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan credits the usual fall seasonal shift, not the election.
business.title: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?

business.b: The biggest US oil company signed a nonbinding memorandum with Venezuela's government and PDVSA to evaluate exploration and production, nearly two decades after leaving and months after its CEO called the country "uninvestable."

business.h: Blacklisted Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips
business.b: Northwestern Polytechnical University bought two H200 AI chips through a third party despite US export restrictions, procurement records reviewed by Reuters show. The school also rented access to the chips this year.

science.h: 'Climate crisis is outrunning us,' Guterres tells COP31
science.b: Opening leaders' talks in Antalya, the UN chief said the last four years were the hottest on record and called for fossil fuels to "go the way of the dinosaurs," warning that fossil fuel interests keep profiting while the planet suffers.

Climate activist Greta Thunberg criticized the COP31 talks co-hosted by Turkiye and Australia, saying negotiations are filled with fossil fuel lobbyists and that "everything and everyone we love is at stake."

sports.h: Misiorowski and Schlittler win Cy Young awards unanimously
sports.b: Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski (1.80 ERA, 252 strikeouts) and the Yankees' Cam Schlittler (1.95 ERA) swept the NL and AL voting, only the third unanimous pair in MLB history.

sports.h: Kansas routs Kentucky at Champions Classic
sports.b: No. 15 Kansas beat No. 24 Kentucky 89-69 as Tre White scored 30 and Trey Kaufman-Renn added 12 points and six assists, even without injured guard Melvin Council Jr.

sports.h: Michigan State upsets No. 2 Duke at Champions Classic
sports.b: Jeremy Fears Jr. had 18 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds as fifth-ranked Michigan State beat Duke 79-73 at the United Center.

sports.h: Alabama jumps to No. 3 in second CFP rankings
sports.b: Alabama rose two spots to No. 3, the earliest a two-loss team has reached the committee's top four, while Tennessee, which beat the Tide, sits at No. 8. The committee chair cited Alabama's top-ranked strength of schedule.

Minnesota reacquired Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a 2027 third-round pick ahead of the trade deadline, after Carson Wentz went 8-for-25 Monday. The deal hands Las Vegas's starting job to No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza.

sports.h: Kevin McGonigle and Sal Stewart win Rookie of the Year
sports.b: The Tigers' McGonigle took 28 of 30 first-place votes in the AL, and the Reds' Stewart won in the NL.

goodnews.h: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient
goodnews.b: Kenya's final Ebola patient has recovered, and the country will be declared disease-free on Dec. 23 if no new cases emerge. Seven of its nine confirmed patients recovered, and there was no community spread.

goodnews.h: Volunteer musicians bring songs to hospitalized veterans
goodnews.b: Volunteers with Musicians On Call play bedside for patients, including in the hospice unit at the DC VA Medical Center, delivering what the nonprofit calls the healing power of music.

local.h: Flatbush building collapse kills at least two
local.b: A three-story mixed-use building collapsed in Brooklyn's Flatbush neighborhood Wednesday afternoon, killing at least two and injuring more than a dozen as firefighters searched the rubble for survivors.
local.title: Building collapse in Brooklyn kills two, injures more than a dozen

local.h: East Side's Cinema 123 closes after 60 years
local.b: The Angelika theater near the Queensboro Bridge screened its last film after its building sold to Roger Equities for $41 million, weeks after the Kips Bay AMC announced it will close.
local.title: Manhattan’s East Side loses another movie theater to development

local.h: Teen arrested in killing of Bronx boy walking to school
local.b: Police arrested a 17-year-old in the Oct. 29 shooting death of 15-year-old Javits Frimpong near Crotona Park. The motive is not yet clear.
local.title: Teen arrested for fatal shooting of 15-year-old Bronx boy walking to school, NYPD says

local.h: Sanitation supervisors rack up speed camera tickets
local.b: Gothamist found 763 sanitation department cars assigned to supervisors and other staff have collected at least 2,375 speed camera tickets since 2023. Advocates want faster rollout of speed limiters, which Mayor Mamdani supports.
local.title: NYC sanitation supervisors keep speeding on the job, data shows

local.h: Chelsea NYCHA redevelopment splits Mamdani's allies
local.b: Tenant activists at Fulton and Elliott-Chelsea Houses have joined DSA to fight the $1.2 billion plan to replace about 2,000 public housing units with mixed-income development, calling it privatization. Mamdani says a teardown is cheaper than repairs.
local.title: Mamdani’s redevelopment plan for NYCHA complex in Chelsea spills into DSA

periods.name: Thursday
periods.text: A slight chance of rain before 7am, then rain after 10am.  Steady temperature around 58. East wind 10 to 14 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 100%. New precipitation amounts between a half and three quarters of an inch possible.

periods.name: Thursday Night
periods.text: Rain.  Low around 44. Breezy, with a north wind 15 to 20 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 90%. New precipitation amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.

periods.name: Friday
periods.text: Rain.  Temperature falling to around 43 by 10am. North wind 13 to 18 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 100%. New precipitation amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

periods.name: Friday Night
periods.text: A 30 percent chance of rain, mainly after 1am.  Mostly cloudy, with a low around 42. Northwest wind around 11 mph.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: Partly sunny, with a high near 46.

periods.name: Saturday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 42.

localgood.h: Lost Georgia O'Keeffe painting found in East Village closet
localgood.b: A niece helping her aunt settle her affairs found O'Keeffe's landscape "Near Abiquiu, New Mexico I" in a wooden box behind coats. Christie's specialists called the find exceptional.
localgood.title: Long-lost Georgia O’Keeffe painting found in East Village closet
